displayProperties.name: Glacier Grenade

displayProperties.name: Duskfield Grenade

displayProperties.description: A grenade that freezes on impact and sends another seeker to find and freeze targets.
displayProperties.name: Coldsnap Grenade

displayProperties.name: Shatter Grenade

displayProperties.description:
Toss a [Stasis] Stasis Shuriken at targets to damage and slow them.  

Provides multiple charges.
displayProperties.name: Withering Blade

displayProperties.name: Shiver Strike

displayProperties.description: Raise your [Stasis] Stasis staff against your foe. Send a blast of [Stasis] Stasis forward to freeze your targets.
displayProperties.name: Penumbral Blast

displayProperties.name: High Jump

displayProperties.description: While airborne, jump a second time with strong directional control.
displayProperties.name: Strafe Jump

displayProperties.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with strong directional control.
displayProperties.name: Strafe Lift

displayProperties.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with a strong initial burst of momentum.

displayProperties.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with strong directional control.
displayProperties.name: Strafe Glide

displayProperties.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with a strong initial boost of speed.
displayProperties.name: Burst Glide

displayProperties.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with both moderate speed and directional control.
displayProperties.name: Balanced Glide

displayProperties.description:
Summon two Stasis kamas, Silence and Squall, that you throw one after another.

Silence : Creates a flash-freeze blast that freezes and damages targets.

Squall : Creates a Stasis Storm that slows and damages targets caught inside.
displayProperties.name: Silence and Squall

displayProperties.description:
Summon a [Stasis] Stasis gauntlet. While your Super is active:

[Heavy Attack]  : Slam your gauntlet down to create a shockwave that freezes targets and sends out [Stasis] Stasis crystals to freeze additional ones.

[Light Attack]  : Supercharge your Shiver Strike for bonus damage. Sprint through [Stasis] Stasis crystals or frozen targets to shatter them instantly.
displayProperties.name: Glacial Quake

displayProperties.description:
Summon a [Stasis] Stasis staff. While your Super is active:

[Super Primary]  : Cast out a barrage of [Stasis] Stasis shards that freeze targets.

[Super Secondary]  : Cast out a shockwave that shatters all frozen targets.
displayProperties.name: Winter's Wrath

displayProperties.description:
Dodging slows nearby targets.

Slowing targets briefly increases your class ability regeneration.
displayProperties.name: Winter's Shroud

displayProperties.description: Activate while midair to quickly descend and shatter nearby targets on impact. Shattering targets grants you Frost Armor.
displayProperties.name: Shatterdive

displayProperties.description: Your slide distance is greatly increased. Sliding releases a wave that shatters [Stasis] Stasis crystals or frozen targets on contact, along with any other frozen targets nearby.
displayProperties.name: Cryoclasm

displayProperties.description:
Picking up [Stasis] Stasis shards grants stacks of Frost Armor.

While you have Frost Armor, defeating combatants with Stasis or Kinetic weapons may cause them to shatter, damaging other nearby combatants. The shatter chance increases with your Frost Armor stacks.

Taking damage while you have Frost Armor generates melee energy.
displayProperties.name: Tectonic Harvest

displayProperties.description: Shattering a frozen target spawns seekers that track and freeze other nearby targets.
displayProperties.name: Iceflare Bolts

displayProperties.description:
Casting your Rift generates a shockwave that freezes nearby targets, granting you Frost Armor when it does so.

Freezing combatants generates class ability energy.
displayProperties.name: Frostpulse

displayProperties.description: Increases weapon handling and health after freezing a target with [Stasis] Stasis.
displayProperties.name: Whisper of Hedrons

displayProperties.description: Increases the damage and size of the burst of [Stasis] Stasis when you destroy a [Stasis] Stasis crystal or defeat a frozen target.
displayProperties.name: Whisper of Fissures

displayProperties.description: Defeating slowed or frozen targets grants you class ability energy.
displayProperties.name: Whisper of Refraction

displayProperties.description: Slow that you apply to targets lasts longer. For those abilities that linger, their duration will also increase.
displayProperties.name: Whisper of Durance

displayProperties.description: Defeating frozen targets generates an Orb of Power.
displayProperties.name: Whisper of Bonds

displayProperties.description: Shattering a [Stasis] Stasis crystal temporarily boosts your grenade recharge rate. Shattering additional [Stasis] Stasis crystals increases the duration of this benefit.
displayProperties.name: Whisper of Shards

displayProperties.description:
Picking up [Stasis] Stasis shards grants stacks of Frost Armor.

While you have Frost Armor, defeating combatants with Stasis or Kinetic weapons may cause them to shatter, damaging nearby foes. The shatter chance increases with your Frost Armor stacks.

Taking damage while you have Frost Armor generates class ability energy.
displayProperties.name: Grim Harvest

displayProperties.description:
While sliding, activate your charged melee ability to launch a wave of [Stasis] Stasis energy forward that freezes enemy combatants, slows enemy players, and creates [Stasis] Stasis crystals.

Grants an additional melee charge.
displayProperties.name: Howl of the Storm

displayProperties.description: [Grenade]  : Hold to convert your grenade into a [Stasis] Stasis turret that fires slowing projectiles at nearby targets.
displayProperties.name: Bleak Watcher

displayProperties.description: Defeating targets while you have Frost Armor has a chance to create a [Stasis] Stasis shard.
displayProperties.name: Whisper of Chains

displayProperties.description: You gain grenade energy each time you take damage from targets. Having Frost Armor increases the amount of energy gained.
displayProperties.name: Whisper of Torment

displayProperties.description: Shattering a frozen target with a melee attack grants a stack of Frost Armor.
displayProperties.name: Whisper of Fractures

displayProperties.description: Damaging targets with a [Stasis] Stasis melee reloads your weapons and grants you a temporary boost to weapon ready speed.
displayProperties.name: Whisper of Impetus

displayProperties.description:
Your Glacier, Duskfield, Coldsnap, and Shatter grenades have enhanced functionality.

Glacier Grenade: Adds a [Stasis] Stasis crystal and changes the formation.

Duskfield Grenade: Increases slow-field size and creates a small [Stasis] Stasis crystal on impact.

Coldsnap Grenade: Seekers duplicate after freezing a target and create a [Stasis] Stasis crystal on detonation.

Shatter Grenade: Creates additional shrapnel projectiles on detonation. Hitting frozen targets with this grenade refunds some grenade energy.
displayProperties.name: Touch of Winter

displayProperties.description:
Shatter or defeat targets with [Stasis] Stasis abilities or weapons to create a Stasis lance.

[Shoot]  : Throw the lance to freeze targets on impact.

[Melee]  : Slam the lance to the ground to freeze targets in a small area.
displayProperties.name: Diamond Lance

displayProperties.description:
Picking up [Stasis] Stasis shards grants stacks of Frost Armor.

While you have Frost Armor, defeating combatants with Stasis or Kinetic weapons may cause them to shatter, damaging other nearby foes. The shatter chance increases with your Frost Armor stacks.

Taking damage while you have Frost Armor generates grenade energy.
displayProperties.name: Glacial Harvest

displayProperties.description: Nearby [Stasis] Stasis shards track to your position.
displayProperties.name: Whisper of Conduction

displayProperties.description: Primary ammo weapons do increased damage to [Stasis] Stasis crystals and frozen targets.
displayProperties.name: Whisper of Rending

displayProperties.description: Increases the melee energy gained from picking up [Stasis] Stasis shards.
displayProperties.name: Whisper of Hunger

displayProperties.description: Your Frost Armor has increased duration and maximum stack count.
displayProperties.name: Whisper of Rime

displayProperties.description:
Tether foes to a Void Anchor, dramatically weakening and suppressing them for you and your allies.

The Void Anchors fired from Shadowshot pull targets toward the impact point, which then become traps and wait for prey. Void Anchors have increased range and last longer.
displayProperties.name: Shadowshot: Deadfall

displayProperties.description:
Summon a pair of deadly Void blades and stalk the battlefield in a veil of shadows.

[Light Attack]  : Perform a quick melee attack.

[Heavy Attack]  : Perform a heavy attack that weakens your target, and once again vanish from sight.
displayProperties.name: Spectral Blades

displayProperties.description:
Tether foes to a Void Anchor, dramatically weakening and suppressing them for you and your allies.

Fire two volleys of three Void Arrows that seek nearby targets. Shadowshot makes targets volatile and deals increased damage to tethered targets. Defeating tethered targets creates Orbs of Power.

While the Super is active, dealing damage increases the damage of your Void Arrows and Bow weapons.
displayProperties.name: Shadowshot: Moebius Quiver

displayProperties.description:
Create a protective dome for you and your allies.

While inside Ward of Dawn, allies gain Void overshield and increased weapon damage, while targets inside the Ward are weakened.

The Ward's owner also gains increased melee damage while inside and can pick up and throw the Ward's core to reposition the Ward up to two times.
displayProperties.name: Ward of Dawn

displayProperties.description:
[Super]  : Summon a shield of Void Light. 
While Sentinel Shield is active:
[Light Attack]  : Attack.
[Block]  : Block.
[Grenade]  : Perform a Shield Throw.

Guard with Sentinel Shield to create a defensive wall that draws hostile fire. Allies behind the shield have increased survivability, weapon damage, and passive reload.

Guarding allies and blocking damage makes the shield last longer and increases your Shield Throw damage.
displayProperties.name: Sentinel Shield

displayProperties.description:
[Super]  : Summon three Void axes and throw them at your foes one after another. On impact, the axes pull in nearby targets and detonate in a weakening explosion. After exploding, the axes can be picked up by you or your allies and used as a weapon for a short time.

While carrying a Void axe:
[Light Attack]  : Slash forward with your axe, dealing damage and weakening targets.
[Heavy Attack]  : Throw the axe, consuming all remaining ammo.
displayProperties.name: Twilight Arsenal

displayProperties.description:
Step between dimensions to subvert the laws of physics.

[Super Secondary]  : Teleport a short distance and release weakening seekers.

[Super Primary]  : Unleash a deadly Void eruption. A fully charged attack makes targets volatile.
displayProperties.name: Nova Warp

displayProperties.description:
Hurl an explosive bolt of Void Light at a target, disintegrating those caught within its blast.

Nova Bomb creates a singularity that pulls targets inward and continually damages those trapped inside.
displayProperties.name: Nova Bomb: Vortex

displayProperties.description:
Hurl an explosive bolt of Void Light at a target, disintegrating those caught within its blast.

Nova Bomb travels slowly and seeks targets. Detonations shatter into smaller seeker projectiles.
displayProperties.name: Nova Bomb: Cataclysm

displayProperties.description:
Throw a Smoke Bomb that attaches to surfaces and pings enemy radar, then detonates into a disorienting smoke cloud, weakening nearby targets. Targets within the smoke cloud take damage over time.

Upon deployment, makes nearby allies invisible.
displayProperties.name: Snare Bomb

displayProperties.description:
Dash forward, slashing combatants as you pass through them. Deals significantly increased damage to Void-debuffed targets, or targets marked by On The Prowl.
 
Generate Void Overshield for each combatant hit. Defeating at least one combatant grants additional Overshield and refunds melee ability energy.
displayProperties.name: Phantom Surge

displayProperties.description: After sprinting for a short time, use this melee ability to unleash a devastating Shield Bash that suppresses the target. Final blows with Shield Bash grant an Overshield.
displayProperties.name: Shield Bash

displayProperties.description: Hurl your Void Shield toward a target. The shield can ricochet off targets and surfaces, granting Overshield for each target hit.
displayProperties.name: Shield Throw

displayProperties.description:
Launch an unstable ball of Void energy that detonates when it nears a target, pushing them away from the blast and making them volatile.  

Provides multiple charges.
displayProperties.name: Pocket Singularity

displayProperties.description: A grenade that attaches to any surface and emits a torrent of damaging Void Light.
displayProperties.name: Void Spike

displayProperties.description: A grenade that creates a horizontal wall of burning Void Light.
displayProperties.name: Void Wall

displayProperties.description: An explosive grenade that suppresses, preventing targets from using abilities for a short time.
displayProperties.name: Suppressor Grenade

displayProperties.description: A grenade that creates a Vortex that pulls targets inward and continually damages those trapped inside.
displayProperties.name: Vortex Grenade

displayProperties.description: A grenade that splits into many submunitions and covers a large area with multiple explosions.
displayProperties.name: Scatter Grenade

displayProperties.description: A grenade that attaches to targets and explodes twice.
displayProperties.name: Magnetic Grenade

displayProperties.description: A bolt of Void Light that forks on impact into smaller bolts that seek out targets.
displayProperties.name: Axion Bolt

displayProperties.description:
Activate your air move to consume your class ability energy and dive to the ground, damaging targets on impact. Damage is greatly increased if striking while you have any Void status effect.

Damaging opponents with this ability heals you. Defeating combatants with this ability grants Devour.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.
displayProperties.name: Trapper's Ambush

displayProperties.description: Dodging makes you invisible.
displayProperties.name: Vanishing Step

displayProperties.description:
Defeating a weakened, suppressed, or volatile target grants Invisibility and Truesight.

After performing a Stylish Execution, your next melee attack while invisible weakens targets.
displayProperties.name: Stylish Executioner

displayProperties.description:
Periodically marks a nearby combatant as a priority target for you and your team. Entering invisibility immediately marks a target.

Defeating priority targets creates a weakening cloud of smoke that makes you and allies invisible when passing through it. 

When priority targets are defeated, you and nearby allies gain increased weapon reload speed and stability for a short duration and are granted grenade, melee, and class ability energy.
displayProperties.name: On the Prowl

displayProperties.description: Hitting a target with a Void ability or Volatile explosion makes them volatile. Further damage to a volatile target causes them to explode. Grants you and nearby allies health when volatile targets explode near you.
displayProperties.name: Controlled Demolition

displayProperties.description:
Cast your Super to grant Overshield to nearby allies. 

Casting your Barricade grants Overshield to yourself and nearby allies and empowers it, enabling it to slowly regenerate the Overshield of allies bunkering behind it and extend their Overshield duration.
displayProperties.name: Bastion

displayProperties.description:
While you have an Overshield or are inside Ward of Dawn, final blows grant grenade and melee energy, you have increased melee range and damage, and melee final blows restore a small portion of your Overshield and extend its duration.

You gain an additional Shield Throw while in Sentinel Shield.
displayProperties.name: Offensive Bulwark

displayProperties.description:
[Grenade]  : Hold to summon a [Void] Void shield that draws hostile fire and blocks a portion of incoming damage, gradually draining your grenade energy and granting an Overshield over time.

Releasing the grenade input or running out of energy releases a frontal blast from your shield that disorients combatants and deals increased damage based on how much damage was blocked. Final blows with the frontal blast grant you Devour.

Combatants that come in contact with your shield are temporarily disoriented.
displayProperties.name: Unbreakable

displayProperties.description:
[Grenade]  : Overcharge your grenade, making it deadlier and more effective.

Vortex Grenade: Increases the size, linger duration, and pull of the vortex.

Axion Bolt: Detonates twice and has enhanced seekers.

Scatter Grenade: Submunitions track to nearby targets.

Magnetic Grenade, Spike Grenade, Voidwall Grenade, and Suppressor Grenade: Releases a short-range Void blast. Cooldown is reduced.

Grants an additional grenade charge.
displayProperties.name: Chaos Accelerant

displayProperties.description:
Defeat a target with a Void ability to activate Devour.

Your Devour effects are improved, restoring additional health and grenade energy.
displayProperties.name: Feed the Void

displayProperties.description:
Cast your rift to create a Void Soul. When you damage a target with a weapon, your Void Soul flies to them and drains them, doing damage and weakening them. Combatants affected by the Soul are also briefly suppressed.

When a target is being drained, you are granted grenade and melee energy (if running Healing Rift) or health (if running Empowering Rift).

Defeating a target who is being drained by your Void Soul grants class ability energy.

The Void Soul's damage is scaled by the enhanced benefit of the Grenade stat.
displayProperties.name: Child of the Old Gods

displayProperties.description:
Ready this aspect by striking a foe with your powered melee ability.

Once readied, press your melee ability to begin siphoning energy from all combatants in front of you, dealing damage and gathering Overshield and class ability energy from each target.

Soul Siphon's damage is scaled by the enhanced benefit of the Melee stat.
displayProperties.name: Soul Siphon

displayProperties.description: Void ability final blows cause targets to explode.
displayProperties.name: Echo of Expulsion

displayProperties.description: Damaging targets with grenades grants melee energy.
displayProperties.name: Echo of Provision

displayProperties.description: Melee final blows grant grenade energy.
displayProperties.name: Echo of Exchange

displayProperties.description: Your lingering grenade effects (Vortex Grenade, Void Wall, Void Spike, and Axion Bolt) have increased duration.
displayProperties.name: Echo of Remnants

displayProperties.description: Final blows when surrounded by combatants grant Super energy.
displayProperties.name: Echo of Reprisal

displayProperties.description: Your Void grenades weaken targets.
displayProperties.name: Echo of Undermining

displayProperties.description: Void buffs applied to you (Invisibility, Overshield, and Devour) have increased duration.
displayProperties.name: Echo of Persistence

displayProperties.description: Melee final blows start health regeneration for you and nearby allies.
displayProperties.name: Echo of Leeching

displayProperties.description:
After suppressing a target, you gain increased weapon stat for a short duration, and your equipped weapon is reloaded from reserves.

Defeating suppressed targets creates a Void Breach.
displayProperties.name: Echo of Domineering

displayProperties.description: While crouched, you sneak faster and gain enhanced radar resolution.
displayProperties.name: Echo of Dilation

displayProperties.description: Defeating targets with grenades grants Volatile Rounds to your Void weapons.
displayProperties.name: Echo of Instability

displayProperties.description: Defeating weakened targets creates an Orb of Power and a Void Breach.
displayProperties.name: Echo of Harvest

displayProperties.description: Finisher final blows grant Invisibility.
displayProperties.name: Echo of Obscurity

displayProperties.description: Picking up a Void Breach or an Orb of Power grants Devour.
displayProperties.name: Echo of Starvation

displayProperties.description:
Summon a rapid-fire flaming pistol that scorches and disintegrates targets with Solar Light.

Final blows with this weapon refund a Golden Gun round and extend your super duration.

Benefits from being radiant.
displayProperties.name: Golden Gun: Deadshot

displayProperties.description:
Summon a precision flaming pistol that scorches and disintegrates targets with Solar Light.

Your Golden Gun deals massively increased precision damage, overpenetrates targets, and creates Orbs of Power on precision hits.

Benefits from being radiant.
displayProperties.name: Golden Gun: Marksman

displayProperties.description: Vault into the air and unleash a volley of Solar-charged knives that explode and scorch targets.
displayProperties.name: Blade Barrage

displayProperties.description:
Summon a flaming hammer and wreak destruction down upon your enemies.

[Light Attack]  : Throw your hammer at foes.

Upon impact, your hammers shatter into explosive molten shards.
displayProperties.name: Hammer of Sol

displayProperties.description:
Summon a flaming maul and crush targets with the force of an earthquake.

[Light Attack]  : Spin the maul in a circle around you, damaging nearby targets.

[Heavy Attack]  : Slam the maul to the ground and create a cyclone of flames that seeks targets, dealing damage and scorching them.
displayProperties.name: Burning Maul

displayProperties.description:
Fashion Solar Light into blades and smite your foes from the sky.

Your Daybreak projectiles scorch targets on impact.
displayProperties.name: Daybreak

displayProperties.description: Thrust your Sword into the ground, damaging and scorching nearby targets. The sword projects a continuous aura, granting radiant effects and restoration to nearby allies, protecting them from the effects of Stasis.
displayProperties.name: Well of Radiance

displayProperties.description:
Unleash your inner fire, making your equipped weapons radiant and enhancing your abilities.

[Melee]  : Release a supercharged melee attack that launches additional projectiles.

[Grenade]  : Create a sentient flame wisp that seeks out targets and detonates in a scorching explosion, then seeks out other nearby targets.

While Song of Flame is active, you and nearby allies regenerate abilities more quickly, are more resistant to incoming damage, and your [Solar] Solar and Kinetic weapons scorch targets.
displayProperties.name: Song of Flame

displayProperties.description: Quickly throw a knife that deals moderate damage. Precision hits with this knife make you radiant for a short duration.
displayProperties.name: Lightweight Knife

displayProperties.description:
Throw a knife that deals extra precision damage and causes scorched targets to ignite.

Precision final blows with this knife immediately recharge your class ability.
displayProperties.name: Weighted Throwing Knife

displayProperties.description: Throw a fan of flaming knives that scorch targets on hit.
displayProperties.name: Knife Trick

displayProperties.description: Throw a knife that attaches to surfaces upon impact and explodes when it detects a nearby target.

 [Super]  while active to deactivate your Super early, saving Super energy.

Your grapple, Shackle Grenade, Threadling Grenade, and Slicewire Grenade have enhanced functionality.

Your grapple melee spawns three Threadlings.

[Grenade]  : Hold to consume your Shackle Grenade and activate Weaver's Trance. Final blows while Weaver's Trance is active create a suspending detonation.

[Grenade]  : Hold to charge your Threadling Grenade, causing it to weave a Threadling Nest at the impact location that repeatedly spawns Threadlings. 

[Grenade]  : Hold to charge your Slicewire Grenade. The grenade's final detonation will launch submunitions and leave a Tangle in its wake.
displayProperties.name: Mindspun Invocation

displayProperties.description:
Tangles you throw attach to targets and detonate into a suspending burst. Destroying a Tangle creates a suspending burst after a short delay.

Threadling final blows create Tangles or reduce your current Tangle cooldown.
displayProperties.name: The Wanderer

displayProperties.description:
[Air Dodge]  : Dodge while airborne to consume your melee energy and enter the weave, gaining damage resistance from combatants and players. Reactivate your air dodge or cast your Rift to exit the weave, generating Woven Mail for you and nearby allies.

While in the weave, your melee energy is drained and you generate perched Threadlings over time. Threadling hits generate ability energy.
displayProperties.name: Weavewalk

displayProperties.description: Dodge to perform an evasive maneuver with a steady hand. Dodging automatically collects nearby ammo boxes and reloads all weapons.
displayProperties.name: Marksman's Dodge

displayProperties.description: Dodge to perform a deft tumble, avoiding combatant attacks and generating melee ability energy. Energy gain is scaled by your Melee stat. Dodging near enemies increases the energy gain.
displayProperties.name: Gambler's Dodge

displayProperties.description: Creates a large barrier that can be used to reinforce a position with cover, and draws hostile fire when you stand behind it.
displayProperties.name: Towering Barricade

displayProperties.description: Creates a small barrier that you can peek over while aiming down sights; increases weapon reload speed, stability, and range. Draws hostile fire when you stand behind it.
displayProperties.name: Rally Barricade

displayProperties.description: Conjure a well of power that continuously heals those inside it.
displayProperties.name: Healing Rift

displayProperties.description:
Conjure a well of power that increases weapon damage and ability energy regeneration for those inside it.

Defeating combatants while standing in the Rift grants additional ammo generation.
displayProperties.name: Empowering Rift

displayProperties.description: While airborne, jump a second time to reach greater heights.
displayProperties.name: High Jump

displayProperties.description: While airborne, jump a second time with strong directional control.
displayProperties.name: Strafe Jump

displayProperties.description: While airborne, sustain your air control with a second or third jump.
displayProperties.name: Triple Jump

displayProperties.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air to greater heights.
displayProperties.name: High Lift

displayProperties.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with strong directional control.
displayProperties.name: Strafe Lift

displayProperties.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with a strong initial burst of momentum.
displayProperties.name: Catapult Lift

displayProperties.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with strong directional control.
displayProperties.name: Strafe Glide

displayProperties.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with a strong initial boost of speed.
displayProperties.name: Burst Glide

displayProperties.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with both moderate speed and directional control.
displayProperties.name: Balanced Glide

displayProperties.description:
Summon an electrified dagger and throw it in your aim direction.

When the dagger hits a surface or a target, you blink to its location and perform a powerful whirling strike, damaging any nearby targets. Can be reactivated after the strike to perform additional throws.

If the dagger flies for long enough without impacting anything, it detonates and you blink to the detonation location.
displayProperties.name: Storm's Edge

displayProperties.description:
Tether foes to a Void Anchor, dramatically weakening and suppressing them for you and your allies.

The Void Anchors fired from Shadowshot pull targets toward the impact point, which then become traps and wait for prey. Void Anchors have increased range and last longer.
displayProperties.name: Shadowshot: Deadfall

displayProperties.description:
Summon a precision flaming pistol that scorches and disintegrates targets with Solar Light.

Your Golden Gun deals massively increased precision damage, overpenetrates targets, and creates Orbs of Power on precision hits.

Benefits from being radiant.
displayProperties.name: Golden Gun: Marksman

displayProperties.description:
Summon two Stasis kamas, Silence and Squall, that you throw one after another.

Silence : Creates a flash-freeze blast that freezes and damages targets.

Squall : Creates a Stasis Storm that slows and damages targets caught inside.
displayProperties.name: Silence and Squall

displayProperties.description:
Weave a vicious rope dart and tear through your targets.

[Light Attack]  : Swing the rope dart in front of you to deal damage. The tip of the dart deals bonus damage, and defeating targets with the tip causes them to explode.

[Heavy Attack]  : Swing the rope dart in a circular motion to deal heavy damage all around you.

[Grenade]  : Use the grapple to move forward quickly.
displayProperties.name: Silkstrike

displayProperties.description:
[Super]  : Summon three Void axes and throw them at your foes one after another. On impact, the axes pull in nearby targets and detonate in a weakening explosion. After exploding, the axes can be picked up by you or your allies and used as a weapon for a short time.

While carrying a Void axe:
[Light Attack]  : Slash forward with your axe, dealing damage and weakening targets.
[Heavy Attack]  : Throw the axe, consuming all remaining ammo.
displayProperties.name: Twilight Arsenal

displayProperties.description:
Summon a flaming hammer and wreak destruction down upon your enemies.

[Light Attack]  : Throw your hammer at foes.

Upon impact, your hammers shatter into explosive molten shards.
displayProperties.name: Hammer of Sol

displayProperties.description: Hurtle through the air like a missile and crash into targets to inflict meteoric damage.
displayProperties.name: Thundercrash

displayProperties.description:
Summon a [Stasis] Stasis gauntlet. While your Super is active:

[Heavy Attack]  : Slam your gauntlet down to create a shockwave that freezes targets and sends out [Stasis] Stasis crystals to freeze additional ones.

[Light Attack]  : Supercharge your Shiver Strike for bonus damage. Sprint through [Stasis] Stasis crystals or frozen targets to shatter them instantly.
displayProperties.name: Glacial Quake

displayProperties.description:
[Super]  : Create two woven blades and roam the battlefield. While active:

[Light Attack]  : Perform a leaping slash towards nearby targets, severing them on hit and dealing bonus damage to suspended targets. Each successful hit briefly increases your attack speed and grants energy for your heavy attack.

[Heavy Attack]  : Unleash a heavy upward slash, creating two suspending projectiles that seek out targets.
displayProperties.name: Bladefury

displayProperties.description:
Unleash your inner fire, making your equipped weapons radiant and enhancing your abilities.

[Melee]  : Release a supercharged melee attack that launches additional projectiles.

[Grenade]  : Create a sentient flame wisp that seeks out targets and detonates in a scorching explosion, then seeks out other nearby targets.

While Song of Flame is active, you and nearby allies regenerate abilities more quickly, are more resistant to incoming damage, and your [Solar] Solar and Kinetic weapons scorch targets.
displayProperties.name: Song of Flame

displayProperties.description:
Hurl an explosive bolt of Void Light at a target, disintegrating those caught within its blast.

Nova Bomb travels slowly and seeks targets. Detonations shatter into smaller seeker projectiles.
displayProperties.name: Nova Bomb: Cataclysm

displayProperties.description:
Chain Arc Lightning from your hands to electrify targets with devastating streams of Arc Light that intensify over time. Casting Stormtrance creates a jolting shockwave underneath you.

[Sprint]  : Teleport forward, consuming a small amount of Super energy.
displayProperties.name: Stormtrance

displayProperties.description:
Summon a [Stasis] Stasis staff. While your Super is active:

[Super Primary]  : Cast out a barrage of [Stasis] Stasis shards that freeze targets.

[Super Secondary]  : Cast out a shockwave that shatters all frozen targets.
displayProperties.name: Winter's Wrath

displayProperties.description:
[Super]  : Conjure a hail of deadly woven needles.

After embedding themselves in the environment, the needles will re-weave into a host of Threadlings.

Threadlings you create will return to you and perch if they can't find any nearby targets. Damaging targets with your weapons or melee will send out perched Threadlings to attack.
displayProperties.name: Needlestorm

displayProperties.description:
Toss a [Stasis] Stasis Shuriken at targets to damage and slow them.  

Provides multiple charges.
displayProperties.name: Withering Blade

displayProperties.description:
Throw a Smoke Bomb that attaches to surfaces and pings enemy radar, then detonates into a disorienting smoke cloud, weakening nearby targets. Targets within the smoke cloud take damage over time.

Upon deployment, makes nearby allies invisible.
displayProperties.name: Snare Bomb

displayProperties.description: Throw a fan of flaming knives that scorch targets on hit.
displayProperties.name: Knife Trick

displayProperties.description:
A quick strike that temporarily increases your melee damage when defeating a target, stacking three times.

Defeating targets with this, grants class ability energy and restores a small amount of health. Energy gain is scaled by your Class stat.
displayProperties.name: Combination Blow

displayProperties.description: Throw a rope dart that bounces between targets, damaging and severing them. The dart will return to you once it's done, returning melee energy to you for each target hit. Press [Melee] just as the dart gets back to you to catch it and increase the amount of energy returned.
displayProperties.name: Threaded Spike

displayProperties.description: Hurl your Void Shield toward a target. The shield can ricochet off targets and surfaces, granting Overshield for each target hit.
displayProperties.name: Shield Throw

displayProperties.description: Hold input to leap through the air. Releasing unleashes a powerful dash attack that knocks targets back and attaches a delayed Stasis explosive to them.
displayProperties.name: Shiver Strike

displayProperties.description:
After sprinting for a short time, use this melee ability to swing a blazing hammer that scorches your target and deals damage in a cone behind them.

If your target is defeated by Hammer Strike, they ignite.
displayProperties.name: Hammer Strike

displayProperties.description:
[Melee] : Hold while grounded to plant your feet and begin charging your fist with Arc energy.

[Melee] : Release to unleash a devastating blast in front of you, dealing damage that increases with longer charge time.
displayProperties.name: Thunderclap

displayProperties.description: Activate your charged melee ability to dash forward, slashing at targets in front of you and severing them.
displayProperties.name: Frenzied Blade

displayProperties.description: Sling a woven needle that will embed in your target, unraveling them. Activate your melee ability again to chain up to two additional attacks.
displayProperties.name: Arcane Needle

displayProperties.description:
Launch an unstable ball of Void energy that detonates when it nears a target, pushing them away from the blast and making them volatile.  

Provides multiple charges.
displayProperties.name: Pocket Singularity

displayProperties.description: Snap your fingers to create a fan of burning sparks that explode and scorch targets.
displayProperties.name: Incinerator Snap

displayProperties.description:
An extended range melee that jolts your target and chains lightning to nearby targets.

While amplified, it creates an additional set of chains.
displayProperties.name: Chain Lightning

displayProperties.description: Raise your [Stasis] Stasis staff against your foe. Send a blast of [Stasis] Stasis forward to freeze your targets.
displayProperties.name: Penumbral Blast

displayProperties.description:
Weave a grappling hook, and quickly pull yourself forward. Grappling to a Tangle immediately recharges your grenade energy.

During and shortly after grappling, your melee attack deals area damage and unravels targets.
displayProperties.name: Grapple

displayProperties.description: A grenade that attaches to targets and explodes twice.
displayProperties.name: Magnetic Grenade

displayProperties.description: A grenade that detonates on impact, releasing multiple drones that seek nearby targets. Each drone slightly scorches affected targets.
displayProperties.name: Swarm Grenade

displayProperties.description: A grenade that chains bolts of lightning to nearby targets.
displayProperties.name: Arcbolt Grenade

displayProperties.description: A grenade that shatters on impact, leaving behind a field that slows targets and freezes those who do not leave the volume.
displayProperties.name: Duskfield Grenade

displayProperties.description: A grenade that creates walls out of [Stasis] Stasis crystals to block damage and freeze targets; these walls can be shattered for damage.
displayProperties.name: Glacier Grenade

displayProperties.description: An explosive grenade that suppresses, preventing targets from using abilities for a short time.
displayProperties.name: Suppressor Grenade

displayProperties.description: A grenade that sends forth a burning line of fire, dealing damage and scorching targets in its path.
displayProperties.name: Thermite Grenade

displayProperties.description: A grenade that periodically damages targets within its explosion radius.
displayProperties.name: Pulse Grenade

displayProperties.description: A thrown weapon of weighted Strand matter that detonates on impact, suspending targets and creating additional suspending subprojectiles.
displayProperties.name: Shackle Grenade

displayProperties.description: A grenade that creates a Vortex that pulls targets inward and continually damages those trapped inside.
displayProperties.name: Vortex Grenade

displayProperties.description: A grenade that cures allies on impact and creates an Orb of benevolent Solar Light, granting restoration to allies when picked up.
displayProperties.name: Healing Grenade

displayProperties.description: A grenade that calls down a focused lightning storm.
displayProperties.name: Storm Grenade

displayProperties.description: A grenade that freezes on impact and sends another seeker to find and freeze targets.
displayProperties.name: Coldsnap Grenade

displayProperties.description: A woven projectile that reweaves itself into Threadlings while in flight.
displayProperties.name: Threadling Grenade

displayProperties.description: Defeating targets with Kinetic weapons grants you bonus Transcendence energy. Defeating targets with your Super grants you and nearby allies bonus Transcendence energy.
displayProperties.name: Facet of Grace

displayProperties.description: While you have an Arc, Solar, or Void buff, ability final blows grant bonus Darkness Transcendence energy.
displayProperties.name: Facet of Sacrifice

displayProperties.description: Defeating targets afflicted with [Stasis] Stasis or [Strand] Strand debuffs grants bonus Light Transcendence energy.
displayProperties.name: Facet of Devotion

displayProperties.description: Defeating targets while transcendent creates Orbs of Power for your allies.
displayProperties.name: Facet of Generosity

displayProperties.description: While transcendent, your ability final blows explode.
displayProperties.name: Facet of Justice

displayProperties.description: Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants Transcendence energy of the same type.
displayProperties.name: Facet of Honor

displayProperties.description: While you have an elemental buff, your class ability regenerates more quickly.
displayProperties.name: Facet of Hope

displayProperties.description: Your [Arc] Arc, [Solar] Solar, and [Void] Void abilities deal increased damage to targets afflicted with Darkness debuffs.
displayProperties.name: Facet of Courage

displayProperties.description: Rapidly defeating targets with Light damage grants melee energy. Rapidly defeating targets with Darkness damage grants grenade energy.
displayProperties.name: Facet of Balance

displayProperties.description: Defeating targets with grenade final blows grants Volatile Rounds to your [Void] Void weapons. Defeating targets with powered melee final blows grants Unraveling Rounds to your [Strand] Strand weapons.
displayProperties.name: Facet of Bravery

displayProperties.description: Rapidly defeating targets with Light or Darkness damage or Super final blows generates an Elemental pickup of the matching damage type.
displayProperties.name: Facet of Awakening

displayProperties.description:
Freezing or suppressing a target reloads your equipped weapons and increases weapon stability, aim assist, and airborne effectiveness.

Defeating frozen or suppressed targets creates a Stasis Shard or Void Breach.
displayProperties.name: Facet of Command

displayProperties.description: Powered melee hits against targets makes you radiant. Powered melee final blows make you and nearby allies radiant.
displayProperties.name: Facet of Dawn

displayProperties.description: While surrounded by combatants, you are more resistant to incoming damage. While transcendent, the effect is increased.
displayProperties.name: Facet of Protection

displayProperties.description: Melee final blows start health regeneration. While transcendent, melee final blows start health regeneration for you and nearby allies.
displayProperties.name: Facet of Blessing

displayProperties.description: Picking up an Orb of Power grants either Bolt Charge, Restoration, Frost Armor, Woven Mail, or Overshield based on the damage type of your equipped Super.
displayProperties.name: Facet of Purpose

displayProperties.description: Grenade final blows cure you. Transcendence grenade final blows increase the strength of the effect.
displayProperties.name: Facet of Mending

displayProperties.description: Finishers create a detonation that either jolts, scorches, slows, severs, or makes targets volatile based on the damage type of your equipped Super.
displayProperties.name: Facet of Defiance

displayProperties.description: Landing rapid precision hits emits a severing blast from the target. While transcendent, the severing blast is bigger.
displayProperties.name: Facet of Solitude

displayProperties.description: Increases the size and damage of the burst when you shatter a Stasis crystal or frozen target, and increases the area of effect of Solar ignitions.
displayProperties.name: Facet of Ruin

displayProperties.description: Your Void grenades weaken targets, and your Arc grenades jolt targets.
displayProperties.name: Facet of Dominance

displayProperties.description: While you have Frost Armor, melee damage slows your target.
displayProperties.name: Whisper of Reversal

displayProperties.description: [Stasis] Stasis weapon final blows have a chance to create a Stasis Shard.
displayProperties.name: Whisper of Chill

displayProperties.description:
[Air Move]  While airborne, consume your class ability energy to summon your Arc Staff, propelling yourself upward and creating a burst of energy around you that amplifies allies and jolts targets.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.
displayProperties.name: Ascension

displayProperties.description:
Defeating a target affected by any elemental debuff grants invisibility and Truesight.

After performing a Stylish Execution, your next melee attack while invisible weakens targets.
displayProperties.name: Stylish Executioner

displayProperties.description:
Defeat targets to charge up an improvised [Solar] Solar explosive.

[Grenade]  : Throw a [Solar] Solar explosive that can be shot in mid-air to cause an ignition.
displayProperties.name: Gunpowder Gamble

displayProperties.description:
Dodging slows nearby targets.

Slowing targets briefly increases your class ability regeneration.
displayProperties.name: Winter's Shroud

displayProperties.description:
Activating your class ability leaves behind a decoy woven from [Strand] Strand matter that draws the attention of nearby combatants.

After taking significant damage or when combatants approach, the decoy detonates, dealing damage and releasing Threadlings that seek out and attack nearby foes.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.
displayProperties.name: Threaded Specter

displayProperties.description:
[Grenade]  : Hold to summon a [Void] Void shield that draws hostile fire and blocks a portion of incoming damage, gradually draining your grenade energy and granting an Overshield over time.

Releasing the grenade input or running out of energy releases a frontal blast from your shield that disorients combatants and deals increased damage based on how much damage was blocked. Final blows with the frontal blast grant you Devour.

Combatants that come in contact with your shield are temporarily disoriented.
displayProperties.name: Unbreakable

displayProperties.description:
While sliding, activate your charged melee ability to launch a wave of [Solar] Solar energy forward, damaging and scorching targets in front of you as you leap into the air.

While airborne, activate your charged melee again to slam to the ground and create a second larger wave of damaging [Solar] Solar energy. If the wave hits a scorched target, they ignite.
displayProperties.name: Consecration

displayProperties.description:
Critically wounding a target or breaking their shield infuses your melee attacks with Arc energy and increases your melee range against combatants and melee damage against combatants and Guardians for a short time.

Defeating targets with melee attacks makes you amplified and restores a portion of your health. Defeating more powerful combatants increases the amount of health restored.
displayProperties.name: Knockout

displayProperties.description:
Shatter or defeat targets with abilities or [Stasis] Stasis weapons to create a Stasis lance.

[Shoot]  : Throw the lance to freeze targets on impact.

[Melee]  : Slam the lance to the ground to freeze targets in a small area.
displayProperties.name: Diamond Lance

displayProperties.description:
Activate your Barricade ability to create a ripple in reality that travels forward along the ground, suspending and damaging the targets it hits.

Final blows on targets affected by Suspend, Unravel, or Sever grant class ability energy.

This ability's damage increases with your Class stat when your Class stat is 100 or higher.
displayProperties.name: Drengr's Lash

displayProperties.description:
Activate your class ability to summon a [Solar] Solar mortar that lobs flaming projectiles at distant targets. Targets damaged by the mortar are scorched.

Hellion damage is scaled by the enhanced benefit of the Grenade stat.
displayProperties.name: Hellion

displayProperties.description:
Defeat a target with any ability to activate Devour.

Your Devour effects are improved, restoring additional health and grenade energy.
displayProperties.name: Feed the Void

displayProperties.description: While sliding, activate your charged melee ability to blink forward, calling down lightning strikes that jolt targets as you rematerialize. This ability also makes you amplified and grants Bolt Charge.
displayProperties.name: Lightning Surge

displayProperties.description: [Grenade]  : Hold to convert your grenade into a [Stasis] Stasis turret that fires slowing projectiles at nearby targets.
displayProperties.name: Bleak Watcher

displayProperties.description:
Activate your class ability to weave three Threadlings and deploy any Threadlings you have perched.

Dealing damage and defeating targets generates perched Threadlings.

displayProperties.name: Hailfire Spike

displayProperties.name: Freezing Singularity
